paletteToggle.label: Jump to anything
paletteToggle.description: Open the command palette: sources, features, settings.

studioToggle.label: Open or close the Studio
studioToggle.description: The drawer of features on the right.

searchFocus.label: Filter the sidebar
searchFocus.description: Put the cursor in the sidebar's filter, on Sources or History.

featureDraft.label: Open Draft
featureDraft.description: Generate a new document with AI.

featureWorkflows.label: Open Workflows
featureWorkflows.description: Automate recurring tasks across your sources.

featureMeetings.label: Open Meetings
featureMeetings.description: Agents working an objective in a channel you can join.

paneSplit.label: Split right
paneSplit.description: Open a new pane to the right of the focused one.

paneSplitDown.label: Split down
paneSplitDown.description: Open a new pane below the focused one.

paneZoom.label: Maximize the focused pane
paneZoom.description: Fill the workspace with it; again to bring the other panes back.

paneFocusNext.label: Focus the next pane
paneFocusNext.description: Move between the panes of a split workspace.

paneFocusPrevious.label: Focus the previous pane
paneFocusPrevious.description: Move between the panes of a split workspace.

paneClose.label: Close this app
paneClose.description: Close the tab the focused pane is showing.

feedbackReport.label: Report a bug
feedbackReport.description: Open the feedback dialog, with this page and its recent errors attached.
